description: Vercel env var contract for the two in-scope Vercel frontends (task 5cb4a8fe slice 5, AC3 Vercel half). Each VITE_* value is derived from infra/cloud/hostname-matrix.json; tests/cloud/scripts/check-vercel-env-matrix.mjs asserts that on every CI run — the `offline contract tests` job runs the checker and its contract test. Quinn provisions the actual values in the Vercel dashboard per the contract; this file records the contract, not the values. Do not edit a value here without updating the corresponding Vercel environment, and vice versa — the static check exits 1 on drift between the contract and the matrix. PROJECT MODEL: the environment separation for the two frontends is per PROJECT, not per Vercel environment (Quinn's 2026-11-13 decision, task 5cb4a8fe). Each Vercel project below carries exactly ONE environment — its own production deployment target — and `servesEnvironment` records which Sindustries environment that deployment serves. The staging project therefore has no `preview` target: its production deployment target serves the staging custom domain. A project may not carry two environments, and two projects may not serve the same environment for one surface. PROJECT FIELDS: `provisioned` records whether the project exists in the Vercel team today — the two production projects are `false` because they have not been created yet (task fb1240c0 owns provisioning them), so the contract is not mistaken for a live deployment. `branch` records the branch the live deployment is built from, as an OBSERVED fact: the staging deployments serving the stable hostnames were built from `main` (commit 7ba14896). The `mission-control-vercel` branch named by the older mission-control-vercel-deployment tech design was never created in the repository and survives only as a design reference.
